headline_en: Agent progress increasingly depends on harness design, memory, and post-training, while tougher evaluations expose gaps in reliability and control.
headline_zh: Agent 的进步越来越依赖 harness 设计、记忆和 post-training，而更严格的评估正在揭示可靠性与控制方面的缺口。

items.role: Core Products, OpenAI; formerly Claude Code, Anthropic
items.en: OpenAI Core Products product management lead Cat Wu announced that she is joining OpenAI after working on Claude Code at Anthropic. She describes her product direction as building agents that support individuals and teams while keeping users in control.
items.zh: OpenAI Core Products 产品管理负责人 Cat Wu 宣布加入 OpenAI，此前她在 Anthropic 参与 Claude Code。她描述的产品方向是打造支持个人和团队的 agent，同时让用户保持控制权。

items.title: The Inside Story of the 50 Who Built Modern AI With Kevin Roose
items.en: The Takeaway: AI agents can make research and editorial work more rigorous when their responsibilities are explicit, but deciding what deserves human effort remains a human judgment. Kevin Roose, a former New York Times writer and current Machine Gods cohost with Casey Newton, interviewed roughly 150 people for The AGI Chronicles to reconstruct decisions inside frontier labs before private messages and institutional memories disappeared; one revealing artifact is Dario Amadei’s 2017 “big blob of compute hypothesis,” which Roose says helped redirect OpenAI toward scaling general systems rather than specialized models. Roose wrote the book himself but used NotebookLM to search his reporting archive and a Claude Code “council” of agents with distinct skeptic, historian, and storytelling perspectives, whose feedback a master editor agent synthesized; he says this process caught factual errors missed by both him and his human editors, capturing the reversal as “a couple years ago, you know, we had to fact check the AIs and now the AIs fact check me.” His practical distinction is between “weightlifting” tasks, where the struggle produces learning or meaning, and “forklifting” tasks, where automation removes overhead; alongside that workflow advice, he advocates standardized safety testing before model deployment and coordination that gives safety researchers more time.
items.zh: 核心观点：当职责足够明确时，AI agent 可以让研究和编辑工作更严谨，但哪些事情值得亲自投入，仍需人来判断。Kevin Roose 曾任 New York Times 作者，目前与 Casey Newton 共同主持 Machine Gods；他为 The AGI Chronicles 采访了约 150 人，希望在私人消息和机构记忆消失之前，还原 frontier lab 内部的关键决策，其中一个重要材料是 Dario Amadei 在 2017 年写下的“big blob of compute hypothesis”，Roose 认为它推动 OpenAI 从专用模型转向扩大通用系统的规模。Roose 亲自完成写作，但用 NotebookLM 检索采访资料，并在 Claude Code 中组建由怀疑者、历史研究者和叙事编辑等不同视角构成的 agent“议会”，再由主编辑 agent 汇总意见；他说，这套流程发现了他和人类编辑都漏掉的事实错误，正如他所说：“几年前，我们还得给 AI 做事实核查，现在 AI 开始给我做事实核查了。”他的实用区分是“举重”任务和“叉车”任务，前者的努力本身带来学习或意义，后者则适合通过自动化消除繁琐负担；此外，他主张在模型部署前开展标准化安全测试，并通过协调为安全研究争取更多时间。

items.title: OpenAI AI Pipeline Generates 948 Linux Root Escalation Exploits in 30-Hour Run
items.en: The Hacker News reports that OpenAI used an upcoming cyber-focused model in a pipeline to validate and patch 948 Linux local privilege escalation vulnerabilities, spending $1.2 million in API costs. The prototype analyzed 2,308 candidate findings and dynamically reproduced 1,724 vulnerabilities, providing a concrete example of AI-driven security work at substantial scale and cost.
items.zh: 据 The Hacker News 报道，OpenAI 在一套流程中使用即将推出的网络安全专用模型，验证并修补了 948 个 Linux 本地提权漏洞，API 成本为 120 万美元。该原型分析了 2,308 个候选发现，并动态复现了 1,724 个漏洞，为大规模 AI 安全工作及其成本提供了具体案例。

items.title: Gods of straight lines on graphs strike Starburst. I am shocked and puzzled.
items.en: LessWrong: Gods of straight lines on graphs strike Starburst reports roughly linear improvement in leading LLMs since the reasoning era began, measured through a puzzle game about discovering a fictional universe’s physical laws. The measurement deserves caution: its intelligence mapping draws on two early human playthroughs, simulated playthroughs, and intuition, while the comparison includes only four explicitly unrepresentative human scores.
items.zh: LessWrong 的 Gods of straight lines on graphs strike Starburst 报告称，自 reasoning 时代开始以来，领先 LLM 在 Starburst 上的表现大致呈线性提升；这款解谜游戏要求玩家发现虚构宇宙的物理规律。这一测量需要谨慎看待：其智力映射依据包括两次早期人类试玩、模拟试玩和直觉，而用于对照的人类成绩只有四个，作者也明确表示它们不具有人群代表性。

items.title: Investigating vault particles with Claude
items.en: Anthropic Research: Investigating vault particles with Claude announces the first 3D structure of a vault particle found in prokaryotic cells. The post describes how Claude contributed at each stage of the biology research.
items.zh: Anthropic Research 的 Investigating vault particles with Claude 公布了在原核细胞中发现的 vault particle 的首个 3D 结构。文章介绍了 Claude 如何参与这项生物学研究的各个阶段。

items.title: HarnessFlow: MCTS-Guided Harness Optimization for LLM Agents
items.en: HarnessFlow optimizes executable agent harnesses while holding the model and environment fixed, using MCTS to select refinements and a coding agent to implement them from execution feedback. With 15 refinement attempts per benchmark, it reports a 69.48% average score across six benchmarks, beating initial harnesses by 10.89 percentage points and Meta-Harness by 3.95 points. It makes harness search a concrete lever for improving agent capability and execution cost.
items.zh: HarnessFlow 在固定模型和环境的条件下优化可执行的 agent harness，通过 MCTS 选择改进方向，再由 coding agent 根据执行反馈实现修改。在每个 benchmark 进行 15 次改进尝试后，它在六个 benchmark 上取得平均 69.48% 的分数，比初始 harness 高 10.89 个百分点，比 Meta-Harness 高 3.95 个百分点。这表明 harness 搜索是提升 agent 能力并改善执行成本的一个具体途径。

items.title: What Does Multi-Turn Reinforcement Learning Really Improve in LLM Agents?
items.en: Using Pass@(K,T) to vary sampling breadth and interaction depth, this study finds that multi-turn RL gains shrink substantially when turn budgets tighten. Improvements concentrate in error recovery and long-horizon resilience rather than uniformly better individual decisions; BudgetMix RL varies interaction budgets during training to improve robustness across execution settings. The result argues for evaluating agent post-training under deployment-relevant budgets.
items.zh: 这项研究通过 Pass@(K,T) 分别调整采样广度和交互深度，发现多轮 RL 的收益会在轮次预算收紧时明显下降。提升主要集中在错误恢复和长程韧性，而不是每一步决策都更好；作者提出的 BudgetMix RL 在训练中变化交互预算，以提升不同执行条件下的稳健性。这提示 agent post-training 应在接近实际部署的预算下评估。

items.title: When Do Summaries Become Instructions? Unsupported Policy in LLM Agents' Self-Written Handoff Summaries
items.en: This study tests whether agent handoff summaries invent permissions or restrictions and then influence successor actions. Neutralizing false approvals reduced unauthorized actions from 24 to 7 in 120 held-out runs in a post hoc analysis, while a pre-specified prompt change explaining where approval requirements originate reduced unsupported restrictions on held-out templates from 1.8% to 0.3%. The findings make permission provenance an important consideration in context compaction, although evidence that invented restrictions change behavior was fragile.
items.zh: 这项研究检验 agent 的交接摘要是否会编造授权或限制，以及这些表述是否影响后续实例的行动。在一项事后分析中，将虚假授权改为中性内容后，120 次留出运行中的未授权行动从 24 次降至 7 次；另一项预先设定的实验通过在 prompt 中说明审批要求的来源，将留出模板上的无依据限制从 1.8% 降至 0.3%。结果说明，权限来源是 context compaction 中值得重视的问题，但编造的限制是否改变行为，其证据仍较脆弱。

items.title: ViBench 2.0: A Benchmark for Long-Horizon Software Building
items.en: ViBench 2.0 evaluates 17 full-stack products built through 241 successive feature requests, requiring every browser test plan to pass for a build to count as successful. The three strongest models pass up to 98% of individual test plans but complete fully working products in at most 65% of builds, and no evaluated open-weight model delivers one. Eight products are public and nine are held out, making this a useful test of end-to-end reliability beyond isolated coding tasks.
items.zh: ViBench 2.0 评估通过 241 次连续功能请求构建的 17 个 full-stack 产品，只有全部浏览器测试计划通过，构建才算成功。最强的三个模型最多能通过 98% 的单项测试计划，但完整可用产品的构建成功率最高只有 65%，参评的 open-weight 模型则没有完成一个。八个产品公开、九个保留为留出集，使其能够检验超越孤立编程任务的端到端可靠性。

items.title: Agents, Think Only When it Helps
items.en: By perturbing teacher thoughts and actions separately during agent distillation, this paper finds that changing or discarding thoughts usually has little effect on student action performance across the tested benchmarks and model scales. Thought supervision matters when it contains information absent from the corresponding action. This offers a criterion for deciding which reasoning traces are worth retaining in agent training data.
items.zh: 这篇论文在 agent distillation 中分别扰动教师的思考和行动，发现在所测试的 benchmark 和模型规模上，修改或丢弃思考内容通常不会明显影响学生的行动表现。当思考包含对应行动中没有的信息时，思考监督才变得重要。这为判断 agent 训练数据中哪些 reasoning trace 值得保留提供了依据。

items.title: Routes of Reasoning: Reading and Reshaping Test-Time Compute in MoE Models
items.en: This paper uses MoE router logits to identify reasoning behaviors and edits expert routing scores at inference time to curb overthinking without training. Behavior signals generalize across six datasets in five domains, and the intervention reduces generated tokens by a median of 30.4% across four models and four benchmarks. It suggests a more targeted way to control test-time compute than limiting reasoning length alone.
items.zh: 这篇论文利用 MoE router logits 识别不同推理行为，并在 inference 时修改 expert routing 分数，无需训练即可抑制过度思考。行为信号能够在五个领域的六个数据集之间泛化，该干预在四个模型和四个 benchmark 上将生成 token 数的中位数降低了 30.4%。它为控制 test-time compute 提供了比单纯限制推理长度更有针对性的方式。

items.title: Route to Remember: Adaptive Memory Selection for LLM Agents
items.en: Route to Remember uses on-policy self-distillation to transfer user memory from a context-conditioned teacher into a context-free student’s weights, then routes queries between weight memory and text memory with verification and regeneration. On HaluMem, it matches or surpasses strong text-memory baselines while reading fewer tokens per query. The approach explores whether persistent factual memory can reduce the recurring context cost of long-running agents.
items.zh: Route to Remember 通过 on-policy self-distillation，将带用户记忆上下文的教师所掌握的信息转入无需上下文的学生权重，再通过验证和重新生成机制，在权重记忆与文本记忆之间路由查询。在 HaluMem 上，它达到或超过了较强的文本记忆基线，同时减少每次查询读取的 token。该方法探索了持久事实记忆能否降低长期运行 agent 反复付出的上下文成本。

items.title: Objective-Conditioned Active Preference Learning for Multi-Objective Alignment
items.en: OGC-DPO treats each response-pair and objective combination as a separate annotation query, selecting queries that expand objective-specific coverage of the policy’s implicit gradients without an external reward model. It outperforms compared active preference learning methods at the same annotation cost and finds that informative preference conflicts can help training. This directly addresses the labeling cost of aligning models across multiple objectives.
items.zh: OGC-DPO 将每个回答对与目标的组合作为独立标注查询，在不使用外部 reward model 的情况下，选择能够扩展各目标下策略隐式梯度覆盖范围的查询。在相同标注成本下，它优于所比较的主动偏好学习方法，并发现有信息量的偏好冲突可以帮助训练。这直接针对多目标 alignment 的标注成本问题。

items.title: Learning When Human Decisions Matter: Executor-Relative Consultation Value for LLM Agents
items.en: Consultation Value Distillation learns when an agent should spend a limited budget on human input, accounting for how much that input benefits the particular downstream executor. It estimates values offline with Monte Carlo rollouts and distills them into lightweight predictors, improving allocation across batch and sequential settings without deployment-time rollouts. This turns human consultation into an explicit resource-allocation problem for agent workflows.
items.zh: Consultation Value Distillation 学习 agent 应在何时使用有限的人类咨询预算，并考虑同一份人类输入对不同下游执行模型的价值差异。它通过离线 Monte Carlo rollout 估计价值，再蒸馏为轻量预测器，在批量和顺序决策场景中改善分配，部署时无需 rollout。这将 agent 工作流中的人类咨询转化为明确的资源分配问题。

items.title: Zero-Shot Coordination among LLM Agents
items.en: This study isolates coordination challenges in minimal environments with simple scaffolds, finding that frontier LLM agents struggle to understand coordination problems and reason about partners’ beliefs. It proposes coordination-friendly definitions and shows that these can be discovered automatically. The results question how reliably independently developed agents can collaborate without shared specialized scaffolding.
items.zh: 这项研究在使用简单 scaffold 的最小化环境中分离不同协调难题，发现 frontier LLM agent 在理解协调问题和推断伙伴信念方面仍有困难。作者提出 coordination-friendly definitions，并展示了自动发现这类定义的方法。结果对独立开发的 agent 在缺乏共同专用 scaffold 时能否可靠协作提出了疑问。

items.title: Cognitive Bias Signatures in Search-Equipped LLM Agents: A Stage-Resolved Analysis
items.en: Across 10 models and 1,000 synthetic search worlds, controlled experiments show that initial evidence order, failed-work histories, and wrong hypotheses can shape agent search and answers. Opening counter-evidence more often does not necessarily improve accuracy, while dead-end histories can suppress strategy switching beyond what context length alone explains. The study motivates evaluating retrieval, document opening, and evidence use separately rather than treating search access as sufficient correction.
items.zh: 在 10 个模型和 1,000 个合成搜索世界中，受控实验表明，初始证据顺序、失败工作记录和错误假设都可能影响 agent 的搜索过程与答案。更频繁地打开反证不一定提高准确率，而死胡同记录对策略切换的抑制也不能仅用上下文长度解释。这提示评估应分别观察检索、文档打开和证据使用，而不能认为有搜索能力就足以纠错。

items.title: Phonological Knowledge of Chinese Characters in Language Models
items.en: PinyinBench combines behavioral tests, layer-wise probes, and activation steering to examine Chinese phonological knowledge in 17 text-only and multimodal models. DS-v4-flash exceeds 90% on homophone judgments when characters share no phonological features, but drops to 72% when only tone differs; tone is decodable internally yet much harder to influence through steering. The findings distinguish possessing linguistic information from being able to use it reliably.
items.zh: PinyinBench 结合行为测试、逐层 probing 和 activation steering，研究 17 个纯文本及多模态模型的汉字语音知识。当汉字不共享任何语音特征时，DS-v4-flash 的同音判断准确率超过 90%，但在仅声调不同的情况下下降至 72%；声调信息虽能从内部表示中解码，却更难通过 steering 影响生成。结果区分了模型拥有语言信息与能够可靠使用这些信息这两件事。

items.title: ARR October reviewing
items.en: A second-year NLP PhD student reports being handed their professor’s double-digit ARR review assignments despite lacking expertise in many of the papers’ areas. The post connects pressure to use AI in peer review with excessive workloads, expertise mismatches, and inadequate supervision, offering a concrete account of incentives that can undermine review quality.
items.zh: 一名 NLP 博士二年级学生称，导师将两位数的 ARR 审稿任务全部交给自己，但其中许多论文领域超出了自己的专业范围。这篇帖子把同行评审中使用 AI 的压力与过重工作量、专业不匹配和指导不足联系起来，具体呈现了可能损害审稿质量的激励机制。

items.title: ⚠️ RedNote cookie expired
items.en: The RedNote login cookie is no longer accepted, so notes below (if any) are title-only without full text or direct links. To fix: open a logged-in www.rednote.com tab, copy the full `cookie` request header from DevTools → Network, and replace REDNOTE_COOKIE in ~/.follow-builders/.env.
items.zh: RedNote 登录 cookie 已失效，下方笔记（如有）只剩标题，没有正文和直达链接。修复方法：在已登录的 www.rednote.com 页面打开 DevTools → Network，复制完整的 cookie 请求头，替换 ~/.follow-builders/.env 里的 REDNOTE_COOKIE。
